records.jp: ライム！　ユズまで……！
records.en_original: Lime! And Yuzu too?!
records.en: Lime! And Yuzu too?!

records.jp: 久しぶり、ヒナちゃん！<CR>会いたかったよー！！
records.en_original: Long time no see, Hina! I've missed you so much!!
records.en: Long time no see, Hina-chan!<CR>I've missed you so much!!

records.jp: よかった、無事だったんだね
records.en_original: Thank goodness you're safe.
records.en: Thank goodness you're safe.

records.jp: うん、ライムたちは大丈夫
records.en_original: Yeah, we're okay.
records.en: Yeah, we're okay.

records.jp: あれ、ユーコさん……？
records.en_original: Wait, Yuko?
records.en: Wait, Yuko-san...?

records.jp: 会ったことあるの？
records.en_original: Have you met before?
records.en: Have you met before?

records.jp: はい、前に学校で……
records.en_original: Yeah, we met at school.
records.en: Yeah, we met at school.

records.jp: あっ……
records.en_original: Oh, uh...
records.en: Oh, uh...

records.jp: じ、実はね……私の名前はユーコじゃなくて<CR>司城夕月なの
records.en_original: A-actually...my name isn't Yuko, it's Yuzuki Shijou.
records.en: A-actually...my name isn't Yuko,<CR>it's Shijou Yuzuki.

records.jp: 司城来夢。<CR>ラーコっていう酷い名前は忘れて
records.en_original: I'm Lime Shijou. Forget about that awful Lako name she gave me.
records.en: I'm Shijou Lime.<CR>Forget about that awful Lako name she gave me.

records.jp: あの時は準備が整ってなくて色々事情が<CR>話せなかったから、咄嗟に誤魔化しちゃったの
records.en_original: Back then, I wasn't prepared and there was a bunch of stuff we couldn't talk about, so I just made something up in the moment.
records.en: Back then, I wasn't prepared and there was a bunch of stuff we<CR>couldn't talk about, so I just made something up in the moment.

records.jp: ごめんね、しほちん
records.en_original: Sorry, Shihochin.
records.en: Sorry, Shihochin.

records.jp: し、しほちん！？
records.en_original: Shihochin?!
records.en: Shihochin?!

records.jp: ちゃんと名乗れるようになったら、<CR>こう呼びたいなって思ってたんだー
records.en_original: Once I could introduce myself properly, I really wanted to call you that.
records.en: Once I could introduce myself properly,<CR>I really wanted to call you that.

records.jp: 別にいいですけど……しほちんかぁ……
records.en_original: That's okay, I guess... But "Shihochin," huh?
records.en: That's okay, I guess... But "Shihochin," huh?

records.jp: それよりも、これからの話。<CR>雫世界のこと
records.en_original: Anyway, let's talk about what comes next—about the Oasis.
records.en: Anyway, let's talk about what comes<CR>next—about the Oasis.

records.jp: 改めて、ユズと考え直したんだけど
records.en_original: Yuzu and I thought things over again.
records.en: Yuzu and I thought things over again.

records.jp: 結局ここまで終末的な状況だと、ライムたちの力では、<CR>消滅まで数秒の時間稼ぎをするくらいしかできない
records.en_original: With things being so apocalyptic, the only thing we can do is buy a few seconds before annihilation.
records.en: With things being so apocalyptic, the only thing we<CR>can do is buy a few seconds before annihilation.

records.jp: リフレクターの数が圧倒的に足りないの<CR>
records.en_original: There just aren't nearly enough Reflectors.
records.en: There just aren't nearly enough<CR>Reflectors.

records.jp: 今ここにいない子あわせても両手の指で<CR>収まるくらいしかいない
records.en_original: Even with the girls who aren't here, you could count them all on two hands.
records.en: Even with the girls who aren't here,<CR>you could count them all on two hands.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんが犠牲になる可能性は、かなり高い
records.en_original: There's a pretty high chance that you'll become a sacrifice, Hina.
records.en: There's a pretty high chance that Hina-chan will become a sacrifice.

records.jp: だからライムたちも<CR>一緒にリフレクターとして力を与える
records.en_original: That's why we'll lend our strength as Reflectors, too.
records.en: That's why we'll<CR>lend our strength as Reflectors, too.

records.jp: それはダメ。<CR>そうしたら、コモンは誰が守っていくの！？
records.en_original: No, you can't! If you do that, who's going to protect the Common?!
records.en: No, you can't!<CR>If you do that, who's going to protect the Common?!

records.jp: リフレクターって、わたしたちにもなれるんですよね？この指輪を使えば
records.en_original: We can become Reflectors too, right? If we use these rings.
records.en: We can become Reflectors too, right? If we use these rings.

records.jp: やめて！<CR>あなたたちまで犠牲になることは……
records.en_original: Stop! I can't let you be sacrificed too...
records.en: Stop!<CR>I can't let you be sacrificed too...

records.jp: どのみち寝ていても結果は同じでしょ？<CR>だったら、私たちはみんな同じ考えだよ
records.en_original: Either way, the outcome's the same if we do nothing, right? Then we're all of one mind.
records.en: Either way, the outcome's the same if we do nothing, right?<CR>Then we're all of one mind.

records.jp: 恐らくこの時に、きららたちが後悔しない選択が<CR>できるようにこれを託したのだろう
records.en_original: Most likely, we were entrusted with this so that we could make a choice we won't regret when this moment came.
records.en: Most likely, we were entrusted with this so that we could make<CR>a choice we won't regret when this moment came.

records.jp: 司令が言っていたように、リフレクターとなった<CR>イローデッドが可能性を秘めているなら
records.en_original: If Eroded who become Reflectors hold potential like the commander said—
records.en: If Eroded who become Reflectors hold<CR>potential like the commander said—

records.jp: 私たちでも、雫世界に大きく貢献できるはず
records.en_original: Then even we should be able to make a big contribution to the Oasis.
records.en: Then even we should be able to make a big contribution to the Oasis.

records.jp: この世界を守ることが我々の使命だ
records.en_original: Protecting this world is our duty.
records.en: Protecting this world is our duty.

records.jp: それにお前たち三人を救えるなら、<CR>こんな名誉なことは無い
records.en_original: And, if it helps save you three as well, nothing could be more honorable.
records.en: And, if it helps save you three as well,<CR>nothing could be more honorable.

records.jp: みんな……
records.en_original: Everyone...
records.en: Everyone...

records.jp: 素晴らしい、感動的な献身だ
records.en_original: How wonderful—such moving devotion.
records.en: How wonderful—such moving devotion.

records.jp: 教えてあげよう。<CR>君たちは間違いなく相当なポテンシャルを持っている
records.en_original: Let me tell you: you all definitely have tremendous potential.
records.en: Let me tell you:<CR>you all definitely have tremendous potential.

records.jp: あやかは知らなかったようだが、<CR>私は既に実証試験を終えているんだ
records.en_original: Ayaka didn't seem to know, but I've already finished the initial tests.
records.en: Ayaka didn't seem to know,<CR>but I've already finished the initial tests.

records.jp: イローデッドｘリフレクターの絶大な威力を、<CR>この二人で
records.en_original: Using these two to combine Eroded and Reflector into an overwhelming power.
records.en: Using these two to combine Eroded and Reflector into an overwhelming<CR>power.

records.jp: うふふ。あの時、司令を泳がせておいたおかげで、<CR>マグロたちがさらにプリプリになったようですね♪
records.en_original: Hee hee. Thanks to letting Commander run free back then, it seems our little tuna have become even more plump and lively!
records.en: Hee hee. Thanks to letting Commander run free back then,<CR>it seems our little tuna have become even more plump and lively!

records.jp: 悠良お兄ちゃん……
records.en_original: Yura...
records.en: Yura-oniichan...

records.jp: ユズ、ライム……<CR>これで何度目の邂逅だろうか
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime... I wonder how many times we've crossed paths by now.
records.en: Yuzu, Lime...<CR>I wonder how many times we've crossed paths by now.

records.jp: 君たちには感謝している。<CR>私の背中を最後に押したのは、間違いなく君たちだ
records.en_original: I owe you both so much. It was you who truly gave me that last push.
records.en: I owe you both so much.<CR>It was you who truly gave me that last push.

records.jp: ライムたちはそんなことのために死んだんじゃない
records.en_original: We didn't die for something like this.
records.en: We didn't die for something like this.

records.jp: まぁ、今となっては些末なこと。<CR>世界の創造の前においては
records.en_original: Well, at this point, it's a trivial matter—especially before the birth of a new world.
records.en: Well, at this point, it's a trivial matter—especially<CR>before the birth of a new world.

records.jp: この世界は再度ゼロから、全く違う秩序で、<CR>創り直すことになる
records.en_original: This world will be remade from zero, under a completely new order.
records.en: This world will be remade from zero,<CR>under a completely new order.

records.jp: 君たちの力を使って
records.en_original: Using your power.
records.en: Using your power.

records.jp: 世界の創造？　創り直す？<CR>なんでそれにわたしたちの力が必要なのよ
records.en_original: Creating a world? Remaking it? Why do you even need our power for that?
records.en: Creating a world? Remaking it?<CR>Why do you even need our power for that?

records.jp: その様子だと君は、この段階でも<CR>未だ気づいていないようだな
records.en_original: From the looks on your faces, it seems you still haven't realized it, even now.
records.en: From the looks on your faces, it seems you<CR>still haven't realized it, even now.

records.jp: 私の後輩としては残念過ぎる結果だ
records.en_original: How disappointing for someone who's supposed to be my junior.
records.en: How disappointing for someone who's supposed to be my junior.

records.jp: 指輪が……共鳴してる？
records.en_original: The rings...are resonating?
records.en: The rings...are resonating?

records.jp: 二人は新しい秩序を作るための大切な巫女だ
records.en_original: These two are precious priestesses for creating the new order.
records.en: These two are precious priestesses for creating the new order.

records.jp: 我々の神であるビナーは、ダアトよりも良い世界を創る
records.en_original: Our god, Binah, will create a better world than Daath ever could.
records.en: Our god, Binah, will create a better world than Daath ever could.

records.jp: ビナー？　ダアト？
records.en_original: Binah? Daath?
records.en: Binah? Daath?

records.jp: ダアトは、お前たち人間を創り出した神。<CR>いわば原種だ
records.en_original: Daath is the god who created you humans—a Sephira, so to speak.
records.en: Daath is the god who created you humans—a Sephira,<CR>so to speak.

records.jp: そしてもう一つの原種、ビナーの眷属は……異灰だ
records.en_original: And the underlings of another Sephira, Binah...are the Testa.
records.en: And the underlings of another Sephira, Binah...are the Testa.

records.jp: この世界のシステムが降らせる灰。ビナーはそれを<CR>利用して、ダアトの世界を破壊していた
records.en_original: The Ash that falls from this world's system—Binah used that to destroy Daath's world.
records.en: The Ash that falls from this world's system—Binah<CR>used that to destroy Daath's world.

records.jp: ビナーを玉座に据えた、新しい世界を創るため
records.en_original: To create a new world with Binah seated upon the throne.
records.en: To create a new world with Binah seated upon the throne.

records.jp: 我々が創り出す世界には、想いなどという不安定で<CR>揺らぎのあるものは存在しない
records.en_original: In the world we create, unstable things like emotions won't exist.
records.en: In the world we create, unstable things<CR>like emotions won't exist.

records.jp: 人間のような不安定なものも存在しない
records.en_original: Nor will unstable beings like humans.
records.en: Nor will unstable beings like humans.

records.jp: この忌々しい妬みや怒り、<CR>友情や愛といった偽善は存在しない
records.en_original: There will be no more hateful envy, anger, or that fake goodwill called friendship and love.
records.en: There will be no more hateful envy, anger,<CR>or that fake goodwill called friendship and love.

records.jp: あるのはただ、正しい秩序だけ。<CR>それがビナーの理想とする世界だ
records.en_original: Only true order will remain. That is Binah's ideal world.
records.en: Only true order will remain.<CR>That's Binah's ideal world.

records.jp: 要するにこの世界は、別の神の意志に<CR>明け渡されるということか？
records.en_original: So basically, you're saying this world is about to be handed over to another god's will?
records.en: So basically, you're saying this world is about<CR>to be handed over to another god's will?

records.jp: そうだ。私の手によって
records.en_original: Exactly. By my hand.
records.en: Exactly. By my hand.

records.jp: 意図的に“乗り換え”たんだ。<CR>どうせ抗えぬ運命なら、賛同できるものに従いたい
records.en_original: I "switched sides" on purpose. If fate is unavoidable, I'd rather follow a cause I can agree with.
records.en: I "switched sides" on purpose.<CR>If fate is unavoidable, I'd rather follow a cause I can agree with.

records.jp: もうこれで、ままならないものに<CR>振り回されることもない
records.en_original: Now I'll never have to be at the mercy of things I can't control anymore.
records.en: Now I'll never have to be at the mercy of things<CR>I can't control anymore.

records.jp: さあ、巫女たち。<CR>その光で、世界を無に帰すんだ
records.en_original: Now, priestesses. Return the world to nothingness with that light.
records.en: Now, priestesses.<CR>Return the world to nothingness with that light.

records.jp: 何をした！？
records.en_original: What did you do?!
records.en: What did you do?!

records.jp: 飽きちゃいました
records.en_original: I got bored.
records.en: I got bored.

records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 私はあなたの世界を拒否します
records.en_original: I reject your world.
records.en: I reject your world.

records.jp: なぜだ？<CR>ここまで私に歯向かう機会を窺っていたのか？
records.en_original: Why? Were you just waiting for your chance to defy me?
records.en: Why?<CR>Were you just waiting for your chance to defy me?

records.jp: いいえ。本気で楽しみにしてたんですよ。<CR>さっきまでは
records.en_original: Nope. Up until a moment ago, I was honestly really excited.
records.en: Nope. Up until a moment ago, I was honestly<CR>really excited.

records.jp: あなたに指輪をもらってから、毎日とても刺激的でした
records.en_original: Ever since you gave me the ring, every day has been thrilling.
records.en: Ever since you gave me the ring, every day has been thrilling.

records.jp: そんな日々が続くなら、もっと楽しいことが待ち受けて<CR>いるなら……と思って、あなたに付き従っていたんです
records.en_original: I went along with you because I thought, if those days would go on, if something even more fun was waiting ahead...
records.en: I went along with you because I thought, if those days would go on,<CR>if something even more fun was waiting ahead...

records.jp: でもあなたが言う新しい世界って、痛みも、苦しみも、<CR>それに伴う悦びも、存在しないんでしょう？
records.en_original: But this "new world" you're talking about, there won't be any pain, or suffering, or the joy that comes from them, right?
records.en: But this "new world" you're talking about, there won't be any pain,<CR>or suffering, or the joy that comes from them, right?

records.jp: 当たり前だ。それこそが、我々の理想とする……
records.en_original: Of course. That's exactly what we're aiming for.
records.en: Of course. That's exactly what we're aiming for.

records.jp: つまんない
records.en_original: Boring.
records.en: Boring.

records.jp: あなたが神の力と繋がっていたとしても、<CR>今この場で何かができるわけではないでしょう
records.en_original: Even if you're connected to the power of a god, you can't actually do anything right here and now, can you?
records.en: Even if you're connected to the power of a god,<CR>you can't actually do anything right here and now, can you?

records.jp: 神そのものではないのですから
records.en_original: You're not actually a god yourself, after all.
records.en: You're not actually a god yourself, after all.

records.jp: 所詮はビナーの駒。<CR>この瞬間に起こる出来事を修正できるほどではない
records.en_original: All you are is Binah's pawn. You're not strong enough to change what happens in this moment.
records.en: All you are is Binah's pawn.<CR>You're not strong enough to change what happens in this moment.

records.jp: さようなら、虎の威を借る狐さん
records.en_original: Goodbye, little fox hiding behind a tiger's stripes.
records.en: Goodbye, little fox hiding behind a tiger's stripes.

records.jp: 駒にも値しない一介の眷属が、反逆など……小賢しい
records.en_original: A mere underling who's not even worth calling a pawn, trying to betray me... So insolent.
records.en: A mere underling who's not even worth calling a pawn, trying to betray me... So insolent.

records.jp: 忘れるな。お前たちの苦しみは永久に続く。<CR>この世界が愚かな三文芝居を繰り返す限り
records.en_original: Don't forget. Your suffering will never end, as long as this world keeps repeating its foolish little play.
records.en: Don't forget. Your suffering will never end,<CR>as long as this world keeps repeating its foolish little play.

records.jp: 覚えておけ。<CR>君と私を分かつのは、言葉だけだ
records.en_original: Remember this: the only thing that separates you and me are words.
records.en: Remember this:<CR>the only thing that separates you and me are words.

records.jp: えっ……
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: うそ……
records.en_original: No way...
records.en: No way...

records.jp: あれー？　皆さんドン引き？
records.en_original: What? Are you all totally put off or something?
records.en: What? Are you all totally put off or something?

records.jp: 別に殺したわけじゃないですよ？<CR>物質として消えただけ
records.en_original: It's not like I killed him or anything. He just vanished materially, that's all.
records.en: It's not like I killed him or anything.<CR>He just vanished materially, that's all.

records.jp: 彼の魂はビナーの元に返されたはず。<CR>その先どうなるかは私の知ったこっちゃありませんが
records.en_original: His soul should've been returned to Binah. What happens to him after that isn't really my concern.
records.en: His soul should've been returned to Binah.<CR>What happens to him after that isn't really my concern.

records.jp: さっきも言ったでしょう？
records.en_original: Didn't I just say it?
records.en: Didn't I just say it?

records.jp: 彼の創造しようとしていた世界が超つまらなかったので<CR>拒否したんです
records.en_original: I rejected him because the world he was trying to create was super boring.
records.en: I rejected him because the world he was trying to create<CR>was super boring.

records.jp: 人と人が醜い感情を剥き出しにして傷つけあう。<CR>それこそが最高で、唯一無二のコミュニケーション
records.en_original: People exposing their ugly feelings and hurting each other—that's the greatest and most unique way of communicating, you know?
records.en: People exposing their ugly feelings and hurting each other—that's the greatest<CR>and most unique way of communicating, you know?

records.jp: それが叶わないのであれば、従う意味なんてありません
records.en_original: If that's not possible, then there's no reason for me to obey.
records.en: If that's not possible, then there's no reason for me to obey.

records.jp: 次に玉座に座るのは……私です♪
records.en_original: The next one to take the throne...is me!
records.en: The next one to take the throne...is me!

records.jp: リーダーくん、今のうちに来てほしいところがあるの
records.en_original: Hey Leader, there's somewhere we want to bring you to right now.
records.en: Leader-kun, there's somewhere we want you to come with us right now.

records.jp: コズミックファングの最奥……<CR>コモンの中枢
records.en_original: The deepest part of the Cosmic Fang...the core of the Common.
records.en: The deepest part of the Cosmic Fang...the core<CR>of the Common.

records.jp: この状況で、本気で言ってんの！？
records.en_original: Are you seriously saying that in this situation?!
records.en: Are you seriously saying that in this situation?!

records.jp: 詩ちゃんに乗っ取られる前にコモンと現実を<CR>切り離して、雫世界に繋げる
records.en_original: Before Uta takes over, we'll have to sever the Common from reality and link it to the Oasis.
records.en: Before Uta-chan takes over, we'll have to sever the Common from reality<CR>and link it to the Oasis.

records.jp: 予定よりちょっと強行だけど、仕方ない
records.en_original: It's a little more forceful than planned, but there's no other way.
records.en: It's a little more forceful than planned, but there's no other way.

records.jp: リーダーくんの力があればできる。<CR>かんなちゃんより安全な方法で
records.en_original: If we have your power, Leader, we can do it. In a way it's even safer than with Kanna.
records.en: With your power, Leader-kun, we can do it.<CR>And it'll be safer than using Kanna-chan.

records.jp: あらあら、何か企んでるみたいですね～？<CR>私にも教えてくださいよ～♪
records.en_original: Ooh, looks like you're up to something, huh? Come on, let me in on it!
records.en: Ooh, looks like you're up to something, huh?<CR>Come on, let me in on it!

records.jp: なんにせよ、駒川さんを止めなきゃ無理みたい
records.en_original: Regardless, it looks like we can't do anything unless we stop Uta.
records.en: Regardless, it looks like we can't do anything unless we stop Komagawa-san.

records.jp: ああ、そしてたぶん、これが我々の最後の戦いだ
records.en_original: Yes, and this is probably our final battle.
records.en: Yes, and this is probably our final battle.

records.jp: リーダーさん……最後の指示、お願いしますっ！
records.en_original: Leader...please, give us your final order!
records.en: Leader-san... please give us your final order!

records.jp: 「全員、駒川詩に攻撃開始！！」
records.en_original: Everyone, attack Uta Komagawa!
records.en: Everyone, attack Komagawa Uta!

records.jp: 了解！！
records.en_original: Got it!
records.en: Got it!
